test.create_query: CREATE TABLE missing_column_steps ( id UInt64, skip UInt8, v Float64, omitted Array(Tuple( f0 Int64, f1 UInt64, f2 Float64, f3 UInt64, f4 Float64, f5 Int8, f6 Float64, f7 Float64, f8 UInt8, f9 UInt32, f10 UInt8, f11 Float64, f12 Float64, f13 UInt8, a0 Array(Tuple(x Int32, y UInt32)), a1 Array(Tuple(x Int32, y UInt32)), a2 Array(Tuple(x Int32, y UInt32)), a3 Array(Tuple(x Int32, y UInt32)))), INDEX idx_skip skip TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, skip_empty_columns_on_insert = 1, serialization_info_version = 'with_missing_columns'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO missing_column_steps (id, skip, v) SELECT number, intDiv(number, 8192) % 2, number / 7 FROM numbers(24000000)
test.query: SELECT omitted FROM missing_column_steps WHERE skip = 0 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT omitted.f0 FROM missing_column_steps WHERE skip = 0 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT omitted FROM missing_column_steps WHERE id < 16000000 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 8192
SELECT sum(id), sum(v), sum(length(omitted)) FROM missing_column_steps WHERE skip = 0 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_samples_no_histograms ( id Tuple(UInt64, LowCardinality(UUID)), samples Array(Tuple(timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64)), histograms Array(Tuple( timestamp DateTime64(3), flags UInt8, counter_reset_hint UInt8, schema Int8, zero_threshold Float64, sum Float64, count_int Int64, zero_count_int Int64, count_float Float64, zero_count_float Float64, positive_int Array(Tuple(index Int32, count Int64)), negative_int Array(Tuple(index Int32, count Int64)), positive_float Array(Tuple(index Int32, count Float64)), negative_float Array(Tuple(index Int32, count Float64)), custom_values Array(Float64))), bucket DateTime64(3), min_time DateTime64(3), max_time DateTime64(3) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, bucket) SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, skip_empty_columns_on_insert = 1, serialization_info_version = 'with_missing_columns'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_samples_no_histograms (id, samples, bucket, min_time, max_time) SELECT (series, reinterpretAsUUID(sipHash128(intDiv(series, 1000)))), arrayMap(i -> (addSeconds(b, i * 60), (series * 1000 + i) / 7), range(60)), b, b, addSeconds(b, 59 * 60) FROM (SELECT number % 10000 AS series, addHours(toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3), intDiv(number, 10000)) AS b FROM numbers(480000))
test.query: SELECT id, samples, `histograms.timestamp` FROM ts_samples_no_histograms WHERE bucket >= toDateTime64('2026-01-02 00:00:00', 3) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT id, samples FROM ts_samples_no_histograms WHERE bucket >= toDateTime64('2026-01-02 00:00:00', 3) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
